title: tc-heatmap
description:
A matrix of rows by columns shaded by value – sequential or diverging, binned or continuous – with a legend, the
highest and lowest cells, a tooltip per cell, selection and a table view.

heading.description: The heading, and the grid's name

rows.description: The rows' labels, top to bottom

columns.description: The columns' labels, left to right

values.description: The values, a row at a time: values[row][column]; null (or missing) is no data

scale.description: Light to dark ("sequential"), or two colours either side of `midpoint` ("diverging")

midpoint.description: The value between the two colours of a diverging scale

steps.description: How many shades the legend bins the values into; 0 shades continuously

min.description: The bottom of the scale; by default the lowest value

max.description: The top of the scale; by default the highest value

showValues.description: Writes each value in its cell

crosshair.description: Lights up the row and column of the cell under the pointer or focus

rowHeader.description: What the rows are, for the table's corner: "Day"

selected.description: The selected cell. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

view.description: The chart or the same numbers as a table. Changed by the Table button unless a tc-view-change listener calls preventDefault()

locale.description: The language for numbers, e.g. "de"; by default the browser's
